2609.11170.title: From Explanations to Interventions: Execution-Guided Counterfactual Synthesis in Temporal Graphs
2609.11170.paper_summary: Can a trace explaining model execution also compute the changes needed for a specified alternative prediction? We propose trace-guided intervention search, which uses executable reasoning traces as an intermediate representation for intervention synthesis. A Specified-Foil Counterfactual edits past events so that a frozen temporal predictor selects a designated foil. Our method constructs facts and replacement values from completed original and foil executions and recovered unmet conditions. Proposal generation constructs edits and selects candidates within a fixed cap; exact replay verifies foil top-1 outcomes among retained edits and compositions. Implemented in LiFTER for continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) and TLogic for temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs), the method improves success over coordinate-based proposal generation by 13.7-34.7 percentage points on four CTDG datasets and 60.0-83.3 points on two TKG datasets under matched downstream search and a proposal cap of 32. Separate shared-candidate comparisons retain 85.7-93.6% of black-box greedy's CTDG success rate with 75.0-80.0% fewer predictor evaluations. A Pulse case study confirms simulator-level survival for five of six interventions. Executable traces thus provide both explanatory evidence and a reusable computational representation for constructing and testing specified alternatives.
2609.11170.paper_summary_zh: 能否透過解釋模型執行的追蹤來計算指定替代預測所需的變更？我們提出了追蹤引導的干預搜尋，該方法使用可執行的推理追蹤作為干預合成的中介表示。指定的對照事實編輯過去的事件，以便凍結的時間預測器選擇指定的對照。我們的方法從完成的原始執行和對照執行及恢復的未滿足條件中構建事實和替代值。提案生成構建編輯並在固定上限內選擇候選者；精確重放驗證保留的編輯和組合中的對照前1結果。在LiFTER中實現，用於連續時間動態圖（CTDGs），以及在TLogic中用於時間知識圖（TKGs），該方法在四個CTDG數據集上比基於坐標的提案生成提高了13.7-34.7個百分點，在兩個TKG數據集上提高了60.0-83.3個百分點，並在匹配的下游搜尋和32的提案上限下進行。單獨的共享候選比較保留了85.7-93.6%的黑箱貪婪的CTDG成功率，並減少了75.0-80.0%的預測器評估。一個Pulse案例研究確認了六個干預中的五個在模擬器級別的生存。可執行的追蹤因此提供了解釋性證據和可重用的計算表示，用於構建和測試指定的替代方案。
2609.11170.author: Minwoo Yu et.al.
